candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show inventory reservation succeeding (200) while payment authorization fails with 503, propagating as 502 at order and checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; root cause within payment (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with payment returning 503 on authorizations across all sampled traces; inventory path is healthy. Bounded candidate is downstream payment failure surfacing as gateway 502, but the underlying payment fault is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations to determine why it returns 503
Gateway logs (excluded) to confirm error propagation path
